items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: While we’re discussing commercialism versus art, a name must be brought up and it occurs at this time in your career that we’re covering right now, and that’s Irving Mills and your relationship with him and his tying in with your band or with your publishing. What exactly was your connection with Irving Mills, when did it start, and what did it do for you, if anything?
